## SECURITIES AND FUTURES COMMISSION

12th Floor, Edinburgh Tower, The Landmark, 15 Queen's Road Central, Hong Kong

19 March 2002

## Circular to Intermediaries

## Dubious Financial Instruments

The  Commission  would  like  to  draw  your  attention  to  the  existence  of  a  dubious Certificate of Deposit bearing the name of 'Asia Funds Investment'.  The depositor's address is in Panama and the certificate is also stamped with a company name similar to one of our registered intermediaries.

Furthermore,  the  Commission  is  aware  that  some  intermediaries  have  received overseas enquiries requesting details of the above Certificate of Deposit.  There is also a  person  purporting  to  be  walk-in  client  trying  to  discount  it.  It  is  not  yet  known whether  that  person  is  working  in  collaboration  with  others  in  the  conduct  of fraudulent activities or is a victim who  has  purchased  the dubious financial instrument.

It is in the interest of intermediaries to ensure that their staff exercise extra caution and act  with  due  care  and  diligence  in  handling  any  unknown  or  suspicious  financial instruments,  whether  presented  by  clients  or  other  intermediaries  in  Hong  Kong  or overseas.  Intermediaries are advised to be careful in this respect to protect their own operations  and  clients  from  financial  loss  arising  from  fraud  and  deception.    If intermediaries come across any suspicious financial instruments, as much information as possible should be obtained about them from relevant parties and reported to the Commission, which will consider whether any action is required.

We recommend that you should issue an appropriate clarification and disclaimer to alert your clients that you are neither the issuer nor the agent of any dubious financial instruments surfaced.
